catalogDefinition.scope: Current Georgetown food and nonalcoholic product catalog for Baked & Wired at 1052 Thomas Jefferson Street NW, across same-day Toast, Cakecups, advance orders, official shop/shipped food, and the official day-specific bread menu.
catalogDefinition.rationale: The exact-address Toast menu is directly readable and fully enumerates same-day food, packaged edible goods, nonalcoholic drinks, retail chocolate, and retail tea. The official Cakecups page is fully enumerable. The advance-order category index and its linked category/product pages expose the complete advance catalog without a date selection, and all four official shop pages enumerate 56 results. The official bread page separately publishes everyday breads and weekday specials. Their deduplicated union defines the complete POC boundary; nonfood rows and headings are explicitly excluded.
